tasks.title: Design Complete Database Schema and ERD
tasks.description: Create comprehensive ERD diagram for extended database schema including user goals, reading sessions, ratings, statistics, bookmarks, and challenges
tasks.details:
Design ERD including: UserEntity, BookEntity (existing), MemoEntity (existing), TagEntity (existing), ReadingGoalEntity, ReadingSessionEntity, BookRatingEntity, ReadingStatisticsEntity, BookmarkEntity, ReadingChallengeEntity, UserChallengeEntity. Define all relationships: User 1:N Goals, User 1:N Sessions, User 1:N Ratings, Book 1:N Sessions, Book 1:N Bookmarks, etc. Include proper normalization and foreign key relationships.
<info added on 2025-08-11T14:27:03.146Z>
Partially completed: Created UserEntity with Supabase integration fields (userId UUID, email, OAuth provider info, sync timestamps). Analyzed existing entities (BookEntity, MemoEntity, TagEntity) and generated initial ERD showing relationships between these 4 core entities. Created comprehensive ERD documentation in .taskmaster/docs/database-erd.md. Identified required modifications: BookEntity, MemoEntity, TagEntity need userId foreign key fields for user ownership. Still pending: Design remaining entities (ReadingGoalEntity, ReadingSessionEntity, BookRatingEntity, ReadingStatisticsEntity, BookmarkEntity, ReadingChallengeEntity, UserChallengeEntity) and complete relationship definitions for full schema.
</info added on 2025-08-11T14:27:03.146Z>
<info added on 2025-08-11T14:55:52.598Z>
PRD scope reduced to focus on core reading diary functionality with Supabase integration. Task now simplified to: 1) Complete core 4-entity ERD (User, Book, Memo, Tag) - already done, 2) Design Supabase database schema that mirrors Room entities for cloud sync, 3) Define data synchronization architecture between local Room database and Supabase backend. Advanced features (reading goals, sessions, ratings, statistics, bookmarks, challenges) removed from current scope and deferred for future iterations.
</info added on 2025-08-11T14:55:52.598Z>

tasks.title: Implement Reading Goals and Statistics Entities
tasks.description: Create entities for user reading goals and comprehensive reading statistics tracking
tasks.details: Create ReadingGoalEntity: id, userId (FK), goalType (MONTHLY/YEARLY), targetType (BOOKS/PAGES), targetValue, currentValue, startDate, endDate, isActive. Create ReadingStatisticsEntity: id, userId (FK), date, booksRead, pagesRead, readingTimeMinutes, averageSessionTime, genreBreakdown (JSON), createdAt. Include proper indexes and constraints.
tasks.testStrategy: Test goal calculation logic, verify statistics aggregation, test time-based queries, validate goal progress tracking

tasks.title: Create Reading Session and Timer Entities
tasks.description: Implement detailed reading session tracking with timer functionality and focus metrics
tasks.details: Create ReadingSessionEntity: id, userId (FK), bookId (FK), startTime, endTime, durationMinutes, pagesRead, startPage, endPage, focusScore (1-10), notes, sessionType (FOCUSED/CASUAL), createdAt. Create SessionBreakEntity for pause tracking: id, sessionId (FK), breakStart, breakEnd, reason. Include proper indexing for time-based queries.
tasks.testStrategy: Test timer accuracy, validate session duration calculations, test focus score algorithms, verify pause/resume functionality

tasks.title: Implement Book Rating and Review System
tasks.description: Create comprehensive rating and review entities with support for multiple review types
tasks.details: Create BookRatingEntity: id, userId (FK), bookId (FK), rating (1-5), oneLineReview, detailedReview, isPublic, helpfulVotes, createdAt, updatedAt. Create RatingCategoryEntity for detailed ratings: id, ratingId (FK), category (PLOT/CHARACTER/WRITING/PACING), score. Include proper constraints and indexes for efficient querying.
tasks.testStrategy: Test rating constraints (1-5 range), validate review text length limits, test aggregation queries for book average ratings, verify user can only rate once per book

tasks.title: Create Bookmark and Highlight Entities
tasks.description: Implement page-based bookmarks and text highlighting functionality
tasks.details: Create BookmarkEntity: id, userId (FK), bookId (FK), pageNumber, chapterName, bookmarkType (BOOKMARK/HIGHLIGHT), highlightedText, notes, colorTag, createdAt. Create BookmarkTagEntity for categorization: id, bookmarkId (FK), tagName, color. Include full-text search indexes for highlighted text and notes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test bookmark retrieval by page/chapter, validate highlight text storage, test search functionality, verify bookmark organization features

tasks.title: Implement Reading Challenge System

tasks.testStrategy: Test challenge creation and joining, validate progress calculation, test completion detection, verify group challenge mechanics
